source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Message stores its key and delegates field access to MessageDatabase. GetMessage constructs that handle without checking whether the row exists; a per-folder lookup separately reads and checks folder ID. EnsureCached fetches absent data and propagates failure. Its current stand-in policy trims an arbitrary quarter at 512 on a cache miss; direct AddMessage insertions do not make512 a strict bound. RemoveMessage still leaves a cached entry and documents the unresolved deleted-message callback issue. MessageExists treats a cache hit as present, while the per-folder removal callback still needs cached folder fields. Do not use handle construction or the present cache as proof of deletion freshness. Selected existing compatibility assertions cover basic membership and cross-folder rejection, not cache eviction or deletion after a hot/cold lookup. No runtime test or failure injection ran.
title: A Panorama Message handle does not establish row existence or cache freshness
